snippet.title: Introducing Justice League Action: RUN | Characters
snippet.description:
Apple App Store: https://app.adjust.com/4xryze 
Google Play App Store: https://app.adjust.com/jc92v4

Play the Justice League Action mobile game! Hand pick your own team of Justice League Action heroes and set the bad guys on the run! And between missions, you can catch your breath — watch videos, learn amazing character facts, and read the best comic books in the universe! 

Available for download!
